comparison.objective: Stop a spinning centrifuge safely, open it, and transfer a sample tube to a rack.
comparison.physical_skill: Interlock-aware waiting/actuation, lid opening, and tube extraction versus screen agitation and retention.
comparison.success_condition: Rotor stopped before lid opening, tube upright in rack; premature opening, apparatus movement, or tube loss fails.
comparison.reason: Tests safe interaction with rotating equipment.
